course.title: Urban Planning Techniques
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value:
Suppose, you are working as a Town Planner in Khulna Development Authority (13)   
(KDA). Your authority is going to develop a residential complex in a fringe area of   
Khulna city-which technique will you prefer between Guided Land Development   
and Land Consolidation for area development? Justify your answer.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2015
